audit_scope.thesis: The factory OS layer is the consolidation layer for all audits: every OS must have ownership, contracts, gates, runtime proof obligations and master-plan implementation work without claiming readiness from registry existence alone.

audit_dimensions.name: Owner and authority
audit_dimensions.question: Does the OS have a clear owner worker and authority boundary?

audit_dimensions.name: Contracts and source of truth
audit_dimensions.question: Does the OS have schemas/templates/docs that define the behavior?

audit_dimensions.name: Enforcement commands and tests
audit_dimensions.question: Can the OS be validated by executable commands and tests?

audit_dimensions.name: Runtime proof
audit_dimensions.question: Is live runtime behavior proven, or only contract-valid?

audit_dimensions.name: Product-specific proof
audit_dimensions.question: Can the OS prove a real product result rather than a fixture or registry?

audit_dimensions.name: Cross-OS integration
audit_dimensions.question: Does the OS connect to neighboring OSs without manual coordination?

audit_dimensions.name: Operator experience
audit_dimensions.question: Does the OS expose useful human projection without leaking internal bureaucracy?

audit_dimensions.name: Master plan readiness
audit_dimensions.question: Is the OS ready to become an implementation workstream in the master update plan?

swiss_watch_reliability_audit.why_it_matters: Reliability lives in fail-closed evidence, replayable control plane and anti-overclaim rules.

method_excellence_audit.why_it_matters: World-class product methods must be executable method engines, not labels.

world_class_process_gap_audit.why_it_matters: Missing world-class product processes become OS-owned capacities, gates, packs or workers.

executor_skill_ecosystem_audit.why_it_matters: Methods only work when real workers, profiles, skills and acquisition lanes exist.

solana_ai_kit_mandatory_routing.why_it_matters: Solana/onchain work must route through Solana AI Kit and remain behind signer/funds/mainnet gates.

security_excellence_audit.why_it_matters: Security must become architecture-first culture, specialist routing, testing, release and learnback.

operator_ui_ux_excellence_audit.why_it_matters: The manager/Telegram/Discord experience must project progress and gates without exposing bureaucracy.
